annotations.text:
300px, always.
The panel opens over someone else's checkout, at the moment they are paying. Every state has to fit that width and stay readable on an unknown background.

The panel is absolutely positioned AGAINST the dock — never a flex sibling.

As a sibling it changed the wrapper's height, which moved the dock out from under the cursor mid-drag and left it hidden behind its own panel. Do not reparent it.
The panel flips above or below the dock depending on room, and transform-origin follows it. A redesign has to work opening in both directions.

Popup and Options are ordinary HTML and share ui.css.

The dock and panel are NOT: their markup and 67 lines of CSS live as template strings inside content.js, in a closed shadow root, and cannot use ui.css. Changes there are edits to a string literal.

No position numbers on the card list. Wallet order carries no meaning any more — top-to-bottom priority was removed, and numbering the rows would keep implying a ranking the ranker does not read.

The popup's 1-6 is different: that IS the ranking.
